page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the opening, the left edge shows the facing page's margin). Running head and page number at top; body text in one column with a brace diagram in the middle of the column (Huius confectura: Materia / Actionibus propriis / am facientium, with Num. references in brace at right); further running text below; a small line "Primae" at the bottom right, and a catchword-like word at the foot right. No margin notes in the column itself.

main_text.p: Figurabat scripturas sanctas spiritus tantum opera & dono, ex seipsis interpretandas. 2.Pet.1.19. 20.21.
Aqua expiationis, erat aqua seperationis & peccati, id est, qua seperati ex immunditia & peccatis purgabantur. Num.19.9.
Erat figura Christi sanguinis idonei, vt fontis perennis, ad nos ab omnibus peccatis purgandos. Leu.13.1. Zach.13.1.
Materia erat Iunix rufa, integra, cui iugum non fuisset impositum. Num.19.2.
Significabat Christum robustum, perfectum, nullis hominum mandatis subditum, sed patri in officium suum ab ipso consecratum, & segregatum. Heb.7.26. Luc.2.49. inter se & ad caermonia comparatis.
Qui in hoc negotio quid faciebant, lotis vestibus venientes in castra immundi erant in vesperam; vt peccati nostri contagionem illustrarent. 2. Cor. 7.1.2.

page.notes: Brace diagrams are rendered as lines; the brace structure is only approximated. Some words in the body are faint and read with uncertainty, e.g. "Iunix", "caermonia", "Iugulationem". The catchword "Primae" at the foot right is treated as text; the page is otherwise cropped at the left edge.
